```{r scratch-viz-setup, include=FALSE}
# Publication figure system: house theme, validated colour-vision-safe palette,
# and vector (PDF) output alongside every raster figure. Applied globally, so
# the plotting code below needs no changes. Guarded: if the library is not
# staged, the notebook renders exactly as it did before.

  for (lib in c("scratch_viz.R", "scratch_report.R")) {
    for (r in roots) {
      p <- file.path(r, lib)
      if (file.exists(p)) { source(p, local = FALSE); break }
    }
  }
})
```

```{r clustering_summary}
    seurat_object, 
    reduction = "umap",
    label = TRUE,
    repel = TRUE,

```

```{r scevan_preparing}

seurat_counts <- GetAssayData(seurat_object, layer = "counts")
# seurat_list <- list(
#   "SPECTRUM-OV-009" = seurat_counts[,grep("SPECTRUM-OV-009", colnames(seurat_counts))[1:1000]],
#   "SPECTRUM-OV-065" = seurat_counts[,grep("SPECTRUM-OV-065", colnames(seurat_counts))[1:1000]],
#   "SPECTRUM-OV-022" = seurat_counts[,grep("SPECTRUM-OV-022", colnames(seurat_counts))[1:1000]]
# )
# 
# sapply(seurat_list, ncol)
# --- 5. Automatically extract sample/group names from barcodes ---
# Here, sample name is the part before the first "_"
barcodes <- colnames(seurat_counts)
sample_prefixes <- unique(sub("_.*", "", barcodes))
cat("Detected sample(s):", paste(sample_prefixes, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# --- 6. Build seurat_list for SCEVAN ---
# Cells per sample handed to SCEVAN. This was HARDCODED to head(cols, 1000) --
# a development limit that was never removed. On a 24,439-cell run it meant
# SCEVAN only ever saw 2,000 cells (8%), so STRATIFY reported a "two-caller
# consensus" while the second caller had no opinion on 92% of cells and 22.6%
# of cells fell to `ambiguous`. 0 = use all cells.
max_per_sample <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(params$max_cells_per_sample))
if (is.na(max_per_sample) || max_per_sample < 0) max_per_sample <- 0L

seurat_list <- setNames(
  lapply(sample_prefixes, function(prefix) {
    cols <- grep(paste0("^", prefix, "_"), barcodes, value = TRUE)
    if (max_per_sample > 0 && length(cols) > max_per_sample) {
      message(sprintf("[SCEVAN] %s: capping %d -> %d cells (max_cells_per_sample)",
                      prefix, length(cols), max_per_sample))
      cols <- head(cols, max_per_sample)
    }
    seurat_counts[, cols]
  }),
  sample_prefixes
)

print(sapply(seurat_list, ncol)) # For sanity check
```

## Copy-number landscape (readable rendering)

```{r oncoheat_readable, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 3.6, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# SCEVAN emits its own OncoHeat PNG, but it prints all ~108 cytoband names along
# one axis, where they collide into an unreadable block, and it clips the sample
# legend. The underlying matrix it plotted is saved alongside it, so redraw the
# same data legibly: samples as rows, regions ordered along the genome, one tick
# per CHROMOSOME rather than per band, and the full band name kept for hover.
#
# Purely additive -- SCEVAN's own figure is still written and nothing about the
# analysis changes. Guarded so a missing file simply skips.
local({
  f <- list.files(".", pattern = "PlotOncoHeat\\.RData$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(f)) { cat("No OncoHeat data found; skipping.\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  ok <- try({
    e <- new.env(); load(f[1], envir = e)
    oh <- as.data.frame(e$oncoHeat)
    stopifnot(nrow(oh) > 0, ncol(oh) > 0)

    regions <- colnames(oh)
    chrom   <- sub("^\\s*([0-9XY]+)\\s*\\(.*$", "\\1", regions)
    band    <- trimws(sub("^[^(]*\\(([^)]*)\\).*$", "\\1", regions))

    d <- data.table::as.data.table(as.table(as.matrix(oh)))
    data.table::setnames(d, c("sample", "region", "value"))
    d[, idx   := match(region, regions)]
    d[, chrom := chrom[idx]]
    d[, band  := band[idx]]
    d[, call  := factor(data.table::fcase(
                   value <= -2, "DEL",  value == -1, "LOSS",
                   value ==  1, "GAIN", value >=  2, "AMP", default = "neutral"),
                 levels = c("DEL", "LOSS", "neutral", "GAIN", "AMP"))]
    d[, hover := sprintf("%s\nchr%s %s\n%s", sample, chrom, band, call)]

    ticks  <- d[, .(at = mean(idx)), by = chrom][order(at)]
    bounds <- d[, .(edge = max(idx)), by = chrom][order(edge)]
    bounds <- bounds[-nrow(bounds)]

    cols <- c(DEL = "#2a4b8d", LOSS = "#8fb3e0", neutral = "#f0efec",
              GAIN = "#f0a58f", AMP = "#c0392b")

    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x = idx, y = sample, fill = call, text = hover)) +
      ggplot2::geom_tile() +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = bounds$edge + 0.5, colour = "#ffffff", linewidth = .35) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = cols, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = ticks$at, labels = ticks$chrom, expand = c(0, 0)) +
      ggplot2::labs(title = "Clonal copy-number landscape by sample",
           subtitle = sprintf("%d cytoband regions across %d samples; ticks mark chromosomes",
                              length(regions), nrow(oh)),
           x = "chromosome", y = NULL) +
      (if (exists("theme_scratch")) theme_scratch() else ggplot2::theme_minimal()) +
      ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                     axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = ggplot2::rel(.8)))

    dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    ggsave("figures/cnv_oncoheat.png", p, width = 11, height = 3.6)
    print(p)
    TRUE
  }, silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(ok, "try-error"))
    cat("OncoHeat redraw skipped:", sub("\n.*", "", as.character(ok)), "\n")
})
```
